_comment: Original BF16/FP16 safetensors, no jailbreak. target=auto picks Bonsai 2 when a published ternary GGUF is supplied, otherwise the lowest-bpw verified recipe for the inspected architecture; the pinned converter has no BF16->NVFP4 quantizer, so NVFP4 output is only reachable by importing an existing NVFP4 checkpoint (see 03). MTP/DFlash2 components are carried through automatically when detected.
